Results.ReviewText: Takes a while to assemble, but it is a terrific BBQ.  Easy to use with simple but effective features.
Results.Title: Terrific BBQ

Results.ReviewText: I’m very happy choosing this size grill. Love the grate that has a flat side, good for vegetables and a wide sear mark on meats. Quality construction.
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: Weber’s quality is worth the price. Always works and performs as expected. No rust or visible corrosion in 3+ years. Warranty lasts for 10
Results.Title: Best grill I have ever owned

Results.ReviewText: After 15 years I traded in my old Genesis for a new Spirit. After a few weeks I’m pleased with the three burner setup and the ability to cook indirectly and directly at the same time. The one disappointment is the stainless steel side tables. They scratch easily from just setting a plate down and have small brown marks in several spots that I’ve not been able to remove. I miss the old durable plastic tables.
Results.Title: Cooks great. Scratches easily.

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Spirit E-310 about a month ago and have great success grilling steaks, burgers, brats and dogs so far. I like the three burner system and the controls work well. The only downside I have found is that the side shelves are stationary (don’t fold down out of the way) and I had to remove one side to have the grill fit where I wanted it when not in use.
Results.Title: Great Medium sized grill

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber and i’ve Been around awhile. Heats up quickly and cooks great. Easy assembly. I love it!
Results.Title: Always wanted a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Très satisfait du rendement de ce bbq le conception est très bien faite
Results.Title: Les grilles ce nettoient très bien cuit bien les a

Results.ReviewText: This grill has made dinner prep such an enjoyable experience.    It ignites and heats up quickly and easily.  The crates have been easy to clean.    Soo satisfied
Results.Title: New best friend

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and clean. Purchased at HD. Already assembled.
Results.Title: Meets our needs- cooks great!

Photos.Caption: Fits perfectly on our back deck.

Results.ReviewText: Bought my grill a month ago and thoroughly love grilling on it. It is so easy to clean too.
Results.Title: Love my Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Cut my finger on your grease pan called and nobody will do anything about it
Results.Title: Cut my finger on your grease pan called and nobody

Results.ReviewText: Overall rating is good except side shelves have rust after just 2 weeks
Results.Title: Great cooking grills and heat distribution

Results.ReviewText: Purchased ours at Lowes. They assembled and set it up at our home free which was the reason we purchased it there. The ten year warranty was the reason we chose Weber. When we registered the grill we saw that the warranty did not cover all parts as we thought.
Results.Title: good grill. We use our grills a lot.

Results.ReviewText: I bought about 2 months ago and the grill has exceeded my expectations thus far.  Thus far, well worth the money.  Simple to use, easy to clean up, nice features other grills don't have.
Results.Title: Great Purchase

Results.ReviewText: Very well made grill! Went together very smoothly and works perfectly. Little pricey but I’m very happy with it so far.
Results.Title: Great working grill!

Results.ReviewText: I have owned other grills over the past 20 years and decided this time to purchase a weber.  It is a fantastic product and I'm kicking myself as to why I waited so long to make the weber leap.
Results.Title: heating surface is even.

Results.ReviewText: Got the grill set up and the igniter did not work.  After much  trying to start it we called customer service and they immediately sent us a igniter kit which we received following day, my husband installed and now all is well. So disappointed at first but problem was resolved.
Results.Title: Rough start but now we Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill cooks everything with no problems!
Results.Title: Glad I  finally wised up

Results.ReviewText: The first E-310  grill lasted for many years and we just wore it out.  Bought second one and love it too.  Weber is the only grill we will use.  The price may seem high at the time of purchase, but you truly do get what you pay for when it comes to grills.
Results.Title: This is our Second one.

Results.ReviewText: Bought mine a month ago. Setup was easy and it worked trouble free first time. Following the Weber cooking instructions fish, steaks and ribs have all turned out excellent.
Results.Title: Everything is straight forward. Easy to understand

Results.ReviewText: Great quality.  Cooks food evenly! I dreaded having to cook on my old grill.  Purchased the Weber last month and am on it almost nightly.
Results.Title: Excellent Value for the money!

Results.ReviewText: Works great, looks great and matches our house. Good size.
Results.Title: Looks great!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had my grill for 2 months and love cooking out with it!
Results.Title: Great Cooking!

Results.ReviewText: As of now I love this grill I have it for one month now so far so good
Results.Title: #1 Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill more than a month ago and I'm very satisfied with my purchase
Results.Title: Grate features and compact size

Results.ReviewText: I bought this bbq less than a month ago and the igniter button does not work.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: great purchase very useful quick ignition clean surface
Results.Title: easy to ignite

Results.ReviewText: I have been cooking over a month and totally happy I purchased the Weber Spirit 310 grill. Even heat on surface. Warms fast and a breeze to move around. Starting is very easy. This is my third Weber  grill in almost 40 years. I gave my old Weber Spirit 2 burner to my son and it’s still going. You can pay more, you can pay less but you won’t get a better grill than a Weber
Results.Title: Even heat

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago to replace another Weber Spirit 310 that rusted and fell apart.  Weber sent us parts to replace the rusted ones, but the fasteners were so rusted we could get the rusted pasted off.  The new grill is sitting on a screened in porch as was the old one and we have used it 4 times. The cheap Chinese stainless steel has already started to rust.  What a piece of junk. The days of Weber being the best are gone.
Results.Title: Made in China--already rusting

Results.ReviewText: Very sleek design, super high heat, ease of use.My only complaint is that is doesn't come with a  rotisserie.
Results.Title: sleek cabinet design

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and the food is wonderful.  No regrets with my purchase.
Results.Title: Works great!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace a large worn out grill.  It is my first Weber and I love it!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: I grilled a perfect roasted pork belly , chicken with crispy skin and filet mignon medium rare
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill and 2 months ago, and should have bought a Weber along time ago
Results.Title: Great consistent heat across the grill surface

Results.ReviewText: I bought this in late July & the prep shelves already have patches of rust. It was assembled at Home Depot so who knows how long it had been in the store with the other bbqs. I plan to contact Weber customer service to discuss. Other than that is a fine bbq
Results.Title: Prep shelves already have patches of  rust

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a bout a month ago, I am so happy with it ability to cook evenly on the perfect grates.  Best BBQ I have ever bought, E-310 Spirit.
Results.Title: Excellent features.

Results.ReviewText:
Food cooks fast.
The only problem is that most of the time food sticks to grates even when they are oiled.
Results.Title: great features

Results.ReviewText: Not nearly as sturdy as my previous Weber gas grill. Had to have wheels and base replaced.  I do move my grill around quite a bit. It does cook nice and even.  Overall I’m happy with this unit. Some of the burner units are already showing signs of deterioration.
Results.Title: Disappointing

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my 1995 Genesis grill only because I’m moving to a smaller house.  This new Spirit is a joy to grill on.  I love cooking on the cast iron grates and the overall appearance and quality I expect from Weber grills.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this bbq based on a significant amount of research, plus my previous experience with Weber BBQs. What I like appreciate about the brand in general includes the following:
Ease of assembly 
Sturdiness 
Quality of parts
Accuracy of the built in thermostat
Ability to hold consistent heat. This is important as I sometimes use it as an oven for baking.
I’ve owned good bbqs in the past but, so far this one takes the prize.
Results.Title: The Ultimate BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
Finally I can BBQ vegetables along side meats. My old grill I had to use both grates for meats, one side for cooking, the other for moving out of the flame ups. Now I can cook both at the same time, and also I can enjoy yard games without holding everybody up when its my turn because I was to busy blowing out flames.
  Now i'm also looking foreword to winter BBQ since I don't have to stand outside in the snow and cold. Not that it was that bad, at least the flame ups were like a make shift fire pit to keep warm by. However, I think now I will get a wireless temp gauge so I can sit in the nice warm house and wait to eat with everyone else.
Results.Title: No more flame ups!

Results.ReviewText: Two years old - best grill ever.  I always purchased cheap one - no more
Results.Title: Great warranty

Results.ReviewText: This is a very nice grill!  The grill heats very fast and holds temperature well after adjusting your desired level.  Grilled meats hold juice and are moist and delicious.  The only issue I have had with the grill is with the drip pan, which does not slide in or out smoothly for cleaning.
Results.Title: Sprint E-310

Results.ReviewText:
So far so good.   The grill is three weeks old.
We do like it.  We have had Weber Grills and think they are the better choice
Results.Title: Weber best grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is extremely well-made.  All the parts are quality parts.  It works well and is easy to operate.  I am very pleased with this product.  It is the perfect size and because there is no burner on the side, there is extra room to put things I need while barbecuing.
Results.Title: I like that the propane tank is stored inside.

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I have ever owned. I wish I would invested in one years ago.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I have ever owned easy to use doesn't burn food.
Results.Title: easy to use

Results.ReviewText: We have had the grill a little over a month and we are still learning how to best use it.  Happy with the performance and excited about becoming more familiar with the grill as we use it.
Results.Title: Best fire box I found and warranty to match

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my old weber that was about 22 years old what a difference between old and new. Much better and easier to control the temp. loved the old weber but new one is much improved and easier to use. I use my grill year around.
Results.Title: Easy to light and keep clean

Results.ReviewText: Very happy. Heats up quick and cooks evenly. Love my Weber.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill- so easy for an 82 year old woman to enjoy!
Results.Title: Easy to move!

Results.ReviewText: It cooks everything just right, I like the 3 burners
Results.Title: Easy to use

Results.ReviewText: Bought grille in April 2019. Paid for assembly and delivery. Damaged in delivery. Too bad for me, Weber sent new control manifold for me to install. Didn't want a project, I wanted a working BBQ. No help from Home Depot where it was purchased and who were responsible for delivery. Installed manifold today Aug 14 2019. Piece of junk still will not warm up more than 450 degrees after running for 30 minutes. Called it a what it is to the customer service woman who hung up on me because I swore. Out hundreds of dollars and no BBQ all summer. Wouldn't recommend to my worst enemy.
Results.Title: Biggest piece of junk on the market

Results.ReviewText: I always noticed the Weber grills when shopping for one, but thought they were overpriced. How much difference can there be in grills? Man, was I wrong. With all my past grills, I had to just put the flame on max and grill away with very little room for adjustments. The Weber   makes adjustments to the temps very easily. I had to adjust my grilling techniques to match this grill. As far as durability is concerned, it seems to be well built, but I have only had it for less than 1 season so I really cant offer any comments. So far, I am totally pleased with the purchase and hopefully I will be for years to come.
Results.Title: Money well spent

Results.ReviewText: Very ray to light burners, heats to cooking heat fast and efficient
Results.Title: Easy start, even heat

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber grill, I've heard how good they are for years, now I know why they get good reviews. My 3 burner Spirit performs well on different tasks, especially lighting, heating to temperature, holding temperature and using propane sparingly. Impressive.
Results.Title: I like the Grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is the third Weber we've owned.  The best feature is that one can practically rebuild a grill with the parts offered.  I just needed a smaller one now that I'm widowed and only grill out a few times a month.
Results.Title: We've always been Weber fans.

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber Spirit E-310.  The last one we had lasted 12 years until the grill rusted away from the table platform.  We love the Spirit E-310 model and opted for this older version instead of the newer ones as I could get a closed in cabinet so my dog or pests wouldn't get to the grease pan.  The knobs are a little confusing but everything else is great!
Results.Title: Weber fan!

Results.ReviewText: Infrequent use of this new item.  Works flawlessly.  All the right features.
Results.Title: gas gage

Results.ReviewText: I have owned the Spirit-310 for over a month now and I’m enjoying using it. I also purchased two grill plates which fit perfectly side by side on this grill. I find these quite useful since I have grilled vegetables (asparagus turns out perfect) fish and bacon. Bacon does produce some flare ups but not enough to burn it (something I couldn’t do with my previous infrared grill because the grease settled in the grooves of the grates and created a smoky mess). I have also grilled different types of steaks (New York, Sirloin, Porterhouse and Cowboy cut ribeye). The thermometer is invaluable for monitoring temperatures although it’s been nerve racking cooking without a meat thermometer. I’m finding recommendations from the chefs on your website and applaud the technique used for the Cowboy cut ribeye where you cook for 20 minutes on each side on indirect heat (about 375 to 400), after resting 10 to 15 minutes it turned out perfectly! I’m looking forward to many successful years of grilling.
Results.Title: Perfect size for a small balcony

Results.ReviewText: I have been using the grill for three months now and am very happy with it.  Clean looks, robust design, and a breeze to clean (meaning it happens more frequently).  It also has the BTUs to get the job done.  The quality of my grilling has improved a great deal since getting this.  Far outperforms the more expensive Napoleon grill it replaced.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had my Weber for three weeks and I haven’t used my inside stove once during that time.  I downsized from a Weber Genesis and was a little worried about the size but friends came over and I cooked 3 ribeyes, two pork chops and a whole row of asparagus with no problem.  I love the easy starting and evenly consistent heating.  And your assembly instructions were on point.  Weber, thank you for another great product.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I just bought this BBQ and it does a great job. Is easy to use and clean up afterwards. Only complaint is that the hose is a bit too short for my liking. When hooked up the hose has no slack, but still works well.
Results.Title: Fantastic Product

Results.ReviewText:
I had a huge choice when it came to purchasing my grill and although I came very close to buying another brand, the Weber brand name kept blocking that final decision . I have had my Weber E 310 now for two months and we are very pleased with it.

The even way in which it cooks your food and how it enhances the foods flavor. The tanks storage compartment and the side tables to work and hang my cooking utensils on. The easy clean up of the grill itself and the grease managing system. Customer service was great at answering my questions and getting me started. 

Delivery was fast and the grill was put together right and comes with an outstanding warranty,  10 years. Easy to move around even with the tank attached. Locking wheels to make sure it stays where you put it. 

Controlling your cooking temperature has never been more easyer and friendlier. This grill is just perfect for my family and I and a welcome addition to my deck for personal reasons or entertaining guest. Weber for Life customer.
Results.Title: Great Features / Well Built

Results.ReviewText:
I love my charcoal Weber, but on short notice I use my gas grill. It heats evenly and sears perfectly. 
One downfall, I've noticed the stainless is hard to clean, even the small grease platters.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Previously we owned an infra-red grill. We missed the charbroil taste the flame added to the food. We can regulate the temperature to cook the meats just as we like them.
Results.Title: makes everything taste better

Results.ReviewText: Happy with our choice of a Weber grill. It has all the features we wanted at a very good price.
Results.Title: great features

Results.ReviewText: Everything is good with the grill except the castes (wheels) had to change them are junk
Results.Title: Good and bad

Results.ReviewText: Bought this a month ago and has exceeded expectations
Results.Title: Great value

Results.ReviewText: I have been so impressed by the overall quality and function of this BBQ.  Assembly was a joy,  the parts are machined and designed so well, all parts fit perfectly with easy to follow directions.  The unit does not waste design on frivolous features. Just a solid, well built BBQ that is sure to last for many years.  I have owned many BBQs by other brands, but will only buy Weber's in the future.
Results.Title: Excellent design and quality

Results.ReviewText: We have to replace the burners twice a year. They rust out.
Results.Title: Burners dont last

Results.ReviewText: I'm not satisfied with the grill. It uses to much propane and has many flare ups.
Results.Title: Grill is easy to move and propane scale

Results.ReviewText: Bought the Weber for my husband.  Should have bought him a Weber years ago.  We love it!
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText:
Love the compact size without scarifying BTU. Prefer the look and quality over the Spirit II.
This is my 4th Weber and I would not consider ever buying another brand.
Results.Title: Great product at a great price!

Results.ReviewText: I bought a month ago this grill and I liked the way cooks and easy to clean .
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I am so happy I finally gave into buying a new gas grill.  I was concerned if I gave up my old cast iron grill with lava rock I would loose some of the smokey flavor.  I was so wrong, food cooks great on the new grill and very flavorful.  The 4 castors make moving the grill so easy.  Very happy this grill has exceeded my expectations.
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText:
Over a year now and working fine.
Much better than my Broil King.
Just love it.
Results.Title: Best Ever!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this for the 4th of July and I love it best bbq ever
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
This grill replaced a Weber which was about 25 years old. While that was also a 3 burner it struggled to get to 450 degrees. The faster and higher heating takes some adjustments by the chef.  I have not tried putting a chips container in this one which I used in the old, but I would imagine it will work great.
We keep ours on a deck with tiles under the grill area for safety reasons. The unit rolls easily and I am able to move it into a screened porch for periods when I do not anticipate frequent use.  The design is clean and the access to the grease pan is easy.
Results.Title: Real Hot, Real Fast

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill on July 4th and have used it 5 or 6 times since then. I am very pleased with the performance given. Going from a 4 burner to this 3 burner has taken a little adjustment, but this grill heats quickly and maintains the desired temperature.
Results.Title: good choice!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill at a local Big Box Store.  They had several that were already assembled on the floor so we purchased one of those after hearing that assembly takes about 3 hours.  Unfortunately all 5 of the grills on the floor had some sort of damage which the store manager said was common?  In my case the side shelves were badly scratched and they said that I could get new ones from Weber via the warranty.  This did not affect function so I did not bother but for the money I would have liked a grill that was not damaged out of the box.  But aside from that after about a month of use we really like this grill.  The electric start works good and the propane level gauge is a nice feature so you don't run out of gas unexpectedly.  The grill heats up evenly and attains temp quick.  Cook times have been excellent and food has been cook evenly.  Nice grill marks are attained and we can notice a improvement in Flavor of the meats we have cooked.  While we have owned grills for 40 years this is our first Weber. It will be a couple of years before I can attest to its durability but my initial impression regarding quality and performance is Weber lives up to the reviews rating it highly.
Results.Title: Solid and Smooth working Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this fab grill about a month ago and could not be happier.  I downsized from a 5-burner infra-red grill and it was the best decision.  The quality is awesome and it cooks so evenly that I will try pizza next.
Results.Title: Great "Little" Grill

Results.ReviewText: I had the same grill in the past, also with three burners  running engthwise. I like the actual shorter ones in a Nine degree angle from the previous because I feel that the heat distribution is more efficient and does not burn as much propane for the same result. I have to say that we re mostly grilling for two people nd therefore only use half of the surface available. What I do not like is the quality of the stainless Steel side topas. I placed a glass dish and scratched the surface! That should not happen!
Results.Title: Sleek and efficient

Results.ReviewText: i sent you guys an email about a month ago about how this grill does not heat up. i read about the safety feature, and u guys sent me a new regulator, but it was on so tight i did not want to break something to get it off. i know thats not your fault. It has been working ok lately, but i thought webers were suppose to be the best, and so far i am not to impressed.
Results.Title: wont warm up

Results.ReviewText: I loved my grill, but a bear used it as a stepping stone to get over a fence and knocked it down. I set it back upright, but it didn't work well. With the help of the person at Weber on the phone, we figured out which parts needed to be replaced.  The parts arrived, easily installed and we are back in business! So happy to have my grill back in action.
Results.Title: Got free parts to repair my 2 year-old grill!

Results.ReviewText: I bought it about a month ago at Home Depot. Works great !
Results.Title: nice machine!

Results.ReviewText: I bought it a month ago and it was a great decision. Good Quality.
Results.Title: Great easy to use features

Results.ReviewText: Not happy with the grill grates that came with this model. The top side of the grate is hard to clean and if you flip them over, the flat side is like cooking in a frying pan. The heat is so intense and hard to control that it is easy to overcook the food. Also, this model is made for the newer propane tanks and not the standard tank. We had to insert our own wood cutout to hold our propane tank.
Results.Title: Nice Looking Grill but Average Performance

Results.ReviewText: I have owned many different grills in the past and finally purchased a Weber grill. You can tell right away the quality of the construction of a Weber. That validation will be realized on your first use and result of the food you grilled.
Results.Title: There is nothing like a “Weber”.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill about a month ago because it seemed well made compared to many others.  And it is well made, at least the materials are good and assembly was well done.  However, it has a weight-based propane cylinder contents gauge which is extremely difficult to hang a full cylinder on.  It works fine once hooked up but it's far from easy to reach under the grill and lift the cylinder up onto the mounting hook.  In addition, the cast iron grills are difficult to work with because the lateral grids are raised well above the fore-aft ones.  Consequently, a spatula will not slide easily under items on the grill because it catches on the lateral ridges.
Results.Title: Well Made, Poorly Designed

Results.ReviewText: We are still putting our Spirit E-310 through its paces, and learning what it can do.  I really appreciate the solid construction.  The heat is really even too.  I haven't been battling hot and cold spots like our old grill.  I need to figure out how long I really need to pre-heat it before cooking on it.  The BTUs might be a little lower than some competitors, but the E-310 will get up to temp with a few extra minutes of pre-heat.  I think the heavy cast-iron grates might need the extra time.  (10-15 minutes?)  Once it's there though, there is nothing unpredictable about the cooking experience.
Results.Title: Even Heat!

Results.ReviewText: Love love love it !! Sooo much better then other brands we have owned
Results.Title: Love all features

Results.ReviewText: I have had the grill roughly a month and wish I had bought it well before that.   It cooks evenly and the built in thermometer is great for getting that perfect starting temp.   The battery operated ignition makes for easy starting every time.  I love the propane tank gauge,  it is not perfectly precise but gives you a good idea what’s left in the tank,  better than any other propane monitoring device I’ve tried.  The cast iron cooking grate cleans easily and the food doesn’t stick to very much at all.   The wheels are plastic and a little flimsy and the sheet metal where the tank mounts to the inside flexes a little under weight of the tank.  We’ll see if these become an issue down the line but I don’t think so.  Weber appears to have made a science out of gas grilling and it shows in the final product.... tasty food!
Results.Title: Solid

Results.ReviewText: I bought this bbq a month ago now, it is my first Weber. I did my research and glad I did as I had to search many a place for this particular one that has the higher lid. The other 310’s have a lower profile but it means you can’t cook a beer can chicken in it. I have now made pizza, roasted chicken, beer can chicken, shrimp on sticks, backed and roast potatoes, veg of all types and pineapple. I am becoming quite the chef! My family likes it. The only complaint, and reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is the knobs. They are plastic and when we got our bbq, already built, they were stripped so have contacted Weber and they have fantastic customer service and are sending me a new set of knobs. It’s too bad that they haven’t created a knob that can’t strip so easily. Other than that, love the heat regularity and speed of heating up. Way better than our many other bbqs that we have replaced over the years. It’s a whole other beast. You will not be disappointed I’m sure!
Results.Title: Love this bbq

Results.ReviewText: Purchased a month ago and we are completely satisfied.
Results.Title: Practical yet hasevery feature needed

Results.ReviewText: I had a problem with one of the casters. I sent Weber an email with pictures not expecting the the problem to be fixed but you guys were great!
Results.Title: Their warranty program is excellent

Results.ReviewText: The grill works perfectly but there is no way an 85 year old can lift and place a full gas tank on the hanger. I've seen more expensive models that come with a slide in tray that makes it infinitely easier to install the gas tank.
Results.Title: Major Problem

Results.ReviewText: Cooks food so evenly easy to use love the gas level feature
Results.Title: Cooking food

Results.ReviewText: This is the third or fourth Weber we have owned.  They are our go to brand.  We know they are great quality and last for years.  Unfortunately they changed something in the design that has changed our opinion.  The LP tank now sits on the ground through a hole in the bottom.  We thought that a part had been left out, but it wasn't.  This makes the grill much more difficult to roll around and move on it's wheels.  Had we realized that prior to purchase, we might have looked at a different brand.  Other than that, we love the grill.  No other negatives.
Results.Title: Design change makes it less desireable

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Spirit grill and my only complaint is that on the Spirit 3 the side arms do not fold down like the Spirit 2.
Results.Title: Very nice grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
